node_definition.done_when: Done when. A new test tests/test_a_run_that_needs_help_reads_help.py checks four things. A blocked run draws → help and counts 1h . A blocked-upstream run and a held run each draw → waiting and count under q , not h . A stored needs you word restores as help . And for every state in the fleet's blocked set, the pane draws help . At the base revision the first three cases fail. The negative control removes the superseded mapping and fails the restore case. The test files importing reckon/crew/ticker.py or reckon/crew/recovery_watch.py add no failure against the base, apart from literals that pin the old word or letter, which change and are named in the manifest. The arms run on the all_debug partition ( env -u SLURM_JOB_ID -u SLURM_JOBID sbatch --partition=all_debug ), one arm at a time with at most -n 4 . Each log is under the run directory, starts with its revision and the literal command, and ends in EXIT= . Ruff check and ruff format --check add no findings on the staged paths. Write paths: reckon/crew/ticker.py , reckon/crew/recovery_watch.py , skills/reckon-build/SKILL.md , the new test, and the test files whose literals change.
